scheme_name: Marriage Assistance to Normal Persons Marrying Orthopedically Differently Abled Persons
other_conditions: Normal person must marry an orthopedically differently abled person.
Both spouses must be above 18 years of age.
If either spouse holds a degree or diploma, increased assistance is provided.
benefits_summary: Provides marriage assistance of ₹25,000 (₹12,500 National Savings Certificate plus ₹12,500 cheque); increased to ₹50,000 (₹25,000 NSC plus ₹25,000 cheque) if either spouse has a degree/diploma, along with a certificate of appreciation and an 8‑gram gold coin.
